items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: The jazz band at that time was Duke Ellington and Jimmy Lunceford. That’s all I recall right off hand.

ctx.x: They were more on the sweet side of music rather than the jazz?
Yeah. They weren’t jazz bands. The jazz band at that time was Duke Ellington and Jimmy Lunceford. That’s all I recall right off hand.
So do you remember how old you were when you had this first experience in Sylvan Beach with this band?
